plainTranslation: With Composite Mercury in the 5th house, you can enjoy expressing yourselves with one another, and your communication can be pleasant, joyful, and fun. You can focus on lighter subjects and topics with one another, not wanting to be too serious, and you can make each other laugh. The danger is that you don’t take the relationship or each other seriously enough when you need to. This can be a good placement for a relationship focused on being creative, or between a parent-child.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
